mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transfers ( transfer_id, payment_id,payment_intent_id,merchant_account_id,amount_value, currency, source_account, target_account, transfer_type, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{transferId},#{paymentId},#{paymentIntentId},#{merchantAccountId}, #{amountValue}, #{currency}, #{sourceAccount},#{targetAccount}, #{transferType}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (transfer_id) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
